title: Cards
summary: The cards layout of the view set: records as cards in a grid whose columns follow its width, a cover the layout draws, a title and up to four fields in the «Кратко» place; «Показать ещё» appends the next page. sf-view layout="cards" draws it where the author turned it on.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The rung of the cards' text and controls.

card-size.description: The card size over layouts.cards size: s, m, l = least card width 224, 288, 352 px at a desktop (--sf-measure-28, --sf-measure-36, --sf-measure-44, C396); the columns follow the width (C306). Empty: the options' size (m).

selectable.description: Cards carry the selection box; Space marks a card, Shift+Space a range.

creatable.description: An empty list offers «Создать» (the create event).

total.description: How many records are under the filter (the host's total). Unset: the records shown.

has-next.description: Whether a further page exists (the answer's has_next). Unset: total is larger than the records shown.

count-known.description: false when the host does not count: «Показано N» without «из M».

keep-selection.description: The marks of records not on screen stay (sf-view sets it: the marks hold across the pages of the cards, C295; each display kind keeps its own marks, C413; view round 14 LV2-2): selected may name records of other pages, and the bar counts every mark.

all-selected.description: Every record under the filter is marked (the bar's «Выбрать все N» in the cards, LV2-7; the table's «Выбраны все N» stays the table's, C413): every card is drawn marked, the bar says the total, an action asks scope all; unmarking one card ends it.

bulk-bar.description: Whether the cards draw their own selection bar. sf-view sets it false: the list's bar stands for the cards, so a switch from the table shows one bar, not two (owner, 2026-11-22; view round 14).

current.description: The record open in the record card beside the list (C305): its card is marked.

records.description: The records shown, in the view's order: every page asked so far (window {page, per_page}).

fields.description: Field descriptors (sf-view's columns): the cover field, the title field and the card fields among them; the card fields are drawn by the Framework field renderers.

options.description: layouts.cards of simai.view-config/1: cover_field (a file field or null; default the first image field), cover {fit: cover|contain, ratio: 1:1|4:3|3:4|16:9}, title_field, card_fields (up to four), card_labels, size s|m|l, density default|compact, more (button), per_page (24). No grouping (C297).

actions.description: The host's actions on a selection (sf-view's bulk actions); also in a card's menu for that record.

empty-context.description: Why the list is empty, as sf-view knows it: {kind: no-data|nothing-found|no-access|error, message?}; drawn by sf-empty-state.

cover.const: file value {label, mime, href, width?, height?, thumb?: {<width>: href}}

appendRecords.summary: The host's next page (the answer to more), for a host without sf-view: appended, a record already shown is not repeated.

sf-view-cards-open.summary: A press on a card, Enter, or «Открыть» in its menu (vocabulary open; trigger pointer|keyboard|menu|api): the host opens the record card (sf-view-properties beside the list, C305).

sf-view-cards-select.summary: The selection changed (vocabulary select); all is true while «Выбраны все N» holds the whole list under its filter and false once it ends (LV2-7, view round 14).

sf-view-cards-more.summary: «Показать ещё»: the host answers the next page; sf-view appends it (records), a bare host calls appendRecords.

sf-view-cards-menu.summary: A card's menu is about to open (right click, Shift+F10, «⋯»); cancel to draw the host's own.

sf-view-cards-apply.summary: A host action chosen on the selection (scope selection) or in a card's menu (scope record); scope all while every record under the filter is chosen.

sf-view-cards-reset.summary: «Сбросить фильтр» where nothing was found: the host clears the search and the filters.

untrusted_inputs: titles, field values and cover addresses (drawn as text, by the field renderers, or as an img src)

accessibility.focus: A list named by aria-label with the count (else «Карточки, N»); one Tab stop for the grid, the arrows by the rows as drawn; Enter opens, Space marks; a polite live region says the position, the selection and its clearing; after the record card closes focus returns to its card.

changes: New: the cards layout (owner decisions C297, C306): records as .sf-card in a grid whose columns follow its width (sizes S, M, L), a cover in a frame of one ratio drawn by the layout (cover or contain, lazy), the title in two lines and up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, «Показать ещё» over the window {page, per_page: 24}, one Tab stop with the arrows by rows, a selection for sf-bulk-actions, empty states by sf-empty-state.

DEV's acceptance return VC-1 (round/view-r4): fieldAlign(field, index) answers end only for a numeric field in the second column (odd index); the template passes the index and marks numbers data-numeric for tabular digits.

Release numbering (view 1.9.0): the same code as 1.0.1 of round/view-r4; 1.0.2 is the same VC-1 change on the superseded round/view-cards f85ac5a (not merged, not released), so the release takes 1.0.3.

View site round (round/view-site, view round 7 open item O1): renderMore draws sf-button (outline, primary, data-more, words more-text / more-plain-text in en and ru) instead of sf-pagination when the cards stand inside sf-view (context.inView); a click on [data-more] asks showMore(). Once the next page is drawn the focus goes back to the more button (or to the last card on the last page) instead of falling to the page.

R8-1 (round/view-r8): js/templates/default.css --sf-view-cards-min reads var(--sf-measure-28|36|44, var(--sf-f4|f8|g1)); the fields grid is minmax(min-content, 1fr) auto, the field and its values wrap (no nowrap, overflow or ellipsis); the phone S grid lays the fields in one column.
View round 9 (round/view-r9): rule.js and component.json relations name cl-bulk-actions (lazy), composition.uses smart.bulk-actions; the pair's field-renderers provenance hash.

View round 12, set 3 (DEV msg-c31ccebd, VHF-12): js/templates/default.css .sf-view-cards__top > .sf-view-cards__box, .sf-view-cards__menu take the title's line height (--sf-view-cards--title-line, text height 1/2 or 1 by size) and centre their control in it.

View round 13 (round/view-r13): js/cards.js cardLabels defaults to true; default.css fields one column, label over value, gaps by role (space-1/2 after the title, space-1/3 between fields); the two-column, end-aligned and phone S rules are gone; docs.md says it.

View modular step 1 (round/view-modular-1): takes its shared code (the Framework field renderers, formats, conditions and filter window, and what two View components share) from the package core smart/view-common once per page, instead of a copy in its own bundle; relation cl-view-common.
keep-selection and all-selected (LV2-2, LV2-7), select carries all, apply scope all; bulk-bar and selectAll(on): one bar under sf-view
LV4-16 label at the value's size
View round 15m: round/view-r14 and round/view-modular-1 joined into one line (merge, no rebase); the number is above both branches.
View round 17: repin on SIMAI Framework pair ui-b4f79e1c58b7 (ui-source e59dbad1c108, core.runtime 1.67.0); provenance of src/smart/field-renderers/index.js.
View round 18: keep-selection and all-selected summaries (C413).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-cards through sf-view layout="cards" for records a person recognises by a picture or a few fields (goods, media, people, projects), where the author of the list turned cards on.
do_not: Do not page or fetch in the element; answer sf-view-cards-more (sf-view does).
Do not use it for records grouped by a field (the board) or by a date (the calendar).
